'''Ventooine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Ventooine system/Legends|Ventooine system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was ruled by the [[Satab]]s until their line was ended by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the local [[Tieress]], [[Chrysalla]]. The planet exported [[Sansanna spice/Legends|sansanna spice]], crystals, and a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] named [[Shadeshine]].
